subject: NovaQuant bakeoff — extension request & commercial pathway
messages:
From: Elliot Barnes <elliot@novaquant.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sourcing Team <procure@novaquant.ai>
Date: 2025-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Bakeoff kickoff and scope

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the quick kickoff earlier. We're lining up our internal eval this week and want to make sure the scope is nailed down: we'll run two workloads (inference for short-chat 32-token flows, and long-context generation ~2k tokens) over a 7–10 day window.

A couple of asks from our side before we spin up:
- Can you confirm whether the trial instances will include KV/prefix cache mimic of our production traffic?
- Will we get stable dedicated capacity for the duration (no noisy-neighbor throttling)?
- Any recommended settings for quantized models when we test the long-context path?

Also, CloudSynth has proposed an on-prem trial with burst capacity and a 14-day dedicated window — they're pushing a price-first narrative. We're not leaning one way but we need to validate throughput and p95 latency for the long runs.

I'm attaching a small sample of our workload (novaquant_workload_sample.tar.gz) so your infra team can size nodes. We'll share benchmark harness scripts on our side.

Can you confirm the trial details and when we can expect the access?

Best,
Elliot
Head of ML Ops
NovaQuant

---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@novaquant.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-02T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Bakeoff kickoff and scope

Elliot — thanks for the sample and the clear scope. We can run both short-chat and long-context workloads; high level next steps:

1) We provision a 14-day dedicated trial cluster (isolated nodes) that will match the KV/prefix behavior — we'll pre-load the prefix cache to simulate your traffic pattern.
2) Default stack: FP16 optimized model with an experimental int8 run for the long-context test (we'll include recommended quantization flags).
3) We'll surface p50/p95 per-sequence latency + token throughput and a per-token cost estimate for both configs.

Proposed timeline: provision tomorrow (Nov 3), start runs Nov 4, initial readout by Nov 10. If you'd like more time we can extend — say 21 days — but we'd need to discuss a small pilot fee or a committed uplift.

Couple of asks from me: please confirm the benchmark harness (script) path and whether we should throttle concurrency to match production RPS.

I'll loop in Karthik for the technical configuration and Marissa for pricing/commercial.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Elliot Barnes <elliot@novaquant.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sourcing Team <procure@novaquant.ai>
Date: 2025-11-04T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Bakeoff kickoff and scope — initial results

Chloe,

Quick update from our side — we completed an initial 48-hour sweep. Attaching the raw CSV (novaquant_benchmark_results.csv). High-level: CloudSynth achieved 10–12% better token throughput on the short-chat path at aggressive concurrency, but latency for long-context tails (p95) was worse beyond 1.5k tokens.

We need two things from Redwood if we want to continue the bakeoff: an extension to 21 days (the team wants extra runs to validate sharded KV cache behavior) and a clearer commercial pathway if Redwood is competitive on long-context stability.

Procurement also asked whether Redwood can offer a short-term usage credit or price protection if we commit to a 3-month reserved commitment after the trial.

Elliot

Attachment: novaquant_benchmark_results.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@novaquant.ai>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-05T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: NovaQuant bakeoff — extension request & commercial pathway

Elliot — thanks for the CSV. I dug into the numbers and we see two clear optimization levers that will materially change the long-context p95:

- Increase per-request KV caching warmup (we can pre-load prefix cache per-session to eliminate cold-start tails).
- Switch to an attention-kernel optimized runtime we recently pushed in 1.8.3; that reduces memory pressure for 2k tokens and smooths p95.

Operational proposal (what we can do to make this competitive):
- Provide the 21-day dedicated trial you requested, with a guaranteed isolated node pool for the duration.
- Technical assist: our infra team will run the optimized kernel and pre-warm KV cache (we'll mirror your harness).
- Commercial: if you sign a 3-month Reserved Capacity commitment within 30 days of trial end, we can offer a 22% usage credit applied to the first month and lock in a 6% per-token price protection for 90 days.

I'm attaching a short proposal (redwood_proposal_v2.pdf) that outlines node sizing, cost math, and SLO language for the dedicated pilot.

If that commercial structure misses the mark, tell us the target economics you're aiming for and we can try to match.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Technical Solutions
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@novaquant.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sourcing Team <procure@novaquant.ai>
Date: 2025-11-05T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final — 21-day trial + commercial sweetener

Elliot / Procurement team — following Karthik's note, we can stand up the 21-day dedicated trial starting Nov 7. Operational commitments: dedicated nodes, kernel optimizations, and pre-warm scripts as described.

Commercially: Chloe here — to make the bakeoff decision easy, we'll add a one-time $35k credit applied to month 1 of a 3-month Reserved Capacity commitment (if executed within 30 days of the trial end) and the 6% per-token price protection for 90 days.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, I'll send a revised SOW for signature (DocuSign link below).
2) We'll provision and share access credentials + a readout template.
3) Karthik's team will coordinate a scheduled pre-warm run before you start.

Decision requested by Nov 12 to ensure the Nov 7 provisioning window.

DocuSign (revised SOW): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/SOW-4391-revised

Thanks — looking forward to getting this validated.

Warmly,
Chloe Martin
